associations.rationale: The type constructs the connecting homomorphism, but it does not itself state exactness of the induced long sequence.
Proves exactness for one local segment involving the connecting morphism, so it is narrower evidence for the long exact sequence.
Proves exactness of the two induced homology maps at a fixed degree, only one local part of the asserted long exact sequence.
Proves exactness for another local segment ending in the connecting morphism, hence gives narrower support for long exactness.
